synonyms: Taraxacum officinale F.H.Wigg. (POWO urn:lsid:ipni.org:names:1003018-2, not accepted)
taxa.taxonomy_note: POWO does not accept T. officinale at species rank; it treats the name as a synonym of the aggregate Taraxacum sect. Taraxacum, which gives the POWO id. GBIF and NCBI accept Taraxacum officinale (GBIF 5394163, authority 'Weber ex F.H.Wigg.'; NCBI 50225). For an aggregate, the GBIF and NCBI ids are the practical choice. NCBI taxid read from the NCBI Taxonomy checklist that GBIF mirrors (dataset fab88965-e69d-4491-a04d-e3198b626e52), because the NCBI pages could not be reached directly (browser rate-limited, E-utilities blocked by robots.txt). WFO id is null because worldfloraonline.org could not be fetched (TLS/robots failure).
